trap.label: ordem dos adjetivos
trap.wrong: It is a study scientific important.
trap.right: It is an important scientific study.
trap.why: Adjetivo vem depois do substantivo em português. Em inglês, antes.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com although: “It is cheap. It is poor.”
rewrite.answer: Although it is cheap, it is poor.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a negativa: “The text mentions the cost.”
rewrite.answer: The text does not mention the cost.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com however: “It is cheap but poor.”
rewrite.answer: It is cheap; however, it is poor.
